from: July book, night 22 (We Rest on You)
p1: Asa was a good king of Judah. He asked his people to look for the Lord and keep His commandments.
One day a very big army came to fight. Asa’s army was much smaller.
So Asa prayed, “Help us, O Lord, for we rest on You.” He leaned on the Lord, like a tired child leans on a dad.
p2: The Lord helped Judah, and the big army ran away. Then Heavenly Father’s Spirit came upon a prophet named Azariah. He told Asa, “The Lord is with you while you are with Him.”
Jesus says it too: “Come unto me, and I will give you rest.” Tonight, lean back on your pillow. Let your body feel soft and safe.
old: Asa was a good king of Judah who loved Heavenly Father. He helped the people get rid of idols and follow God. One day, a HUGE army came to fight against them. There were so many enemies — way more than Asa’s soldiers!
Asa wasn’t sure how they could win. But he didn’t give up or panic. Instead, he cried out to Heavenly Father. “Lord, only You can help us! We trust in You.”
Heavenly Father heard Asa’s prayer. He helped the small army of Judah win! The big enemy army ran away. God’s power is bigger than any problem.
It doesn’t matter how big a problem is. With Heavenly Father, anything is possible! Asa didn’t count on numbers — he counted on God. When we call on the Lord, He helps us. He is our greatest helper.
